enchantment.tbz.protective_weave.desc: Kills grant Woven Armor, which increases damage dealt while active.
enchantment.tbz.reign_havoc.desc: Sustained precision hits or final blows generate lightning strikes from the sky, partially refill the magazine, and provide 1 Bolt Charge.
enchantment.tbz.borpal_weapon.desc: Deals bonus damage to Boss-type entities.
enchantment.tbz.precision_instrument.des: Landing precision hits increases the headshot damage multiplier.
enchantment.tbz.target_lock.desc: Damage increases the longer the weapon's reticle remains on target.
enchantment.tbz.thermal_atomization.desc: In high heat state, this weapon deals more damage and causes targets to explode when defeated.
enchantment.tbz.subsistence.desc: Defeating a target transfers ammunition from reserves and partially refills the magazine.
enchantment.tbz.ambitious_assassin.desc: Overfills the magazine based on the number of kills achieved prior to reloading.
enchantment.tbz.reconstruction.desc: This weapon slowly reloads ammunition on its own, up to double the magazine capacity.
enchantment.tbz.triple_tap.desc: Rapid precision hits load one round into the magazine.
enchantment.tbz.fourth_time_the_charm.de: Rapid precision hits refund two rounds into the magazine.
enchantment.tbz.rewind_rounds.desc: When the magazine is emptied, a portion is refilled from reserves based on the number of hits landed.
enchantment.tbz.mulligan.desc: Missed shots have a chance to refund ammunition directly to the magazine.
enchantment.tbz.trickle_charge.desc: Receiving or releasing Bolt Charge refills a portion of the magazine from reserve ammo.
enchantment.tbz.supercharged_magazine.de: While amplified, ammunition gradually transfers from reserves to the magazine.
enchantment.tbz.reversal_of_fortune.desc: Missing 2 shots returns 1 round to the magazine after a short delay.
enchantment.tbz.heal_clip.desc: Reloading shortly after a final blow heals you.
enchantment.tbz.rolling_storm.desc: Final blows grant a damage-boosting effect.
enchantment.tbz.destabilizing_rounds.des: Defeating a target causes nearby enemies to become Unstable.
enchantment.tbz.incandescent.desc: Defeating a target causes nearby enemies to be Scorched.
enchantment.tbz.chill_clip.desc: Sustained attacks apply Freezing effects to the target.
enchantment.tbz.rimestealer.desc: Defeating a target affected by Freezing grants you Frost Armor.
enchantment.tbz.slice.desc: Hitting enemies applies a Debilitating effect.
enchantment.tbz.withering_gaze.desc: Aiming the weapon for a short period without firing weakens your next target.
enchantment.tbz.butterfly.desc: Aiming the weapon for a short period without firing causes your target to explode upon a final blow for the remainder of the magazine.
enchantment.tbz.explosive_payload.desc: Ammunition explodes on impact, dealing area-of-effect damage.
enchantment.tbz.firefly.desc: Precision kills increase reload speed and cause the target to explode.
enchantment.tbz.meganeura.desc: Precision final blows cause an explosion that deals additional damage based on the number of precision hits landed beforehand.
enchantment.tbz.firmly_planted.desc: Crouching while shooting improves aiming precision and reduces vertical recoil.
enchantment.tbz.adagio.desc: After defeating a target, this weapon's fire rate slows down, but deals additional damage for a short time.
enchantment.tbz.onslaught.desc: Final blows with this weapon increase its fire rate, and multiple kills can refresh the buff.
enchantment.tbz.eye_of_storm_eye.desc: The lower your health, the better the weapon's aiming precision and slightly reduced horizontal recoil.
enchantment.tbz.attrition_orbs.desc: Dealing sustained damage to the same target generates experience orbs.
enchantment.tbz.outlaw.desc: Precision kills dramatically reduce reload time.
enchantment.tbz.wellspring.desc: Defeating enemies with this weapon generates experience orbs.
enchantment.tbz.cooling_baubles.desc: Picking up experience orbs has a chance to reduce the weapon's heat.
enchantment.tbz.shoot_tp_loot.desc: Shooting items and experience orbs from a distance immediately picks them up and places them in your inventory.
